kind: rig: the real local Gatekeeper, agentgateway 1.7.0 as a local binary, gateway-authz as a local process
operator_and_approver: Not recorded. The repository owner decided on 2026-11-19 (development plan 1.6) that this technical software has no operator and approver kept apart: this file records what was run, on which commits and images, and what was seen. It is a record of verification, not a gate decision.
registry_note: the example register; each run fills its placeholders with that run's tenant and client ids, so the filled copy differs from run to run

clock.taken_from: the answer to the first whoami (WB-01), as it reached the caller

dataset.data: the example request of the carrier's documentation, synthetic accounts

cases.title: whoami: the blue tenant's real Gatekeeper token, through the gateway, answers with that account

checks.check: status 200
Succeeded is true
Data is the account number of the blue tenant's account (value not recorded)
gateway-authz decided ACTIVE_ACCOUNT_GRANT for whoami.get
no Set-Cookie from the carrier reaches the caller (the stand-in sets one)

cases.title: create, get by process code, delete: one whole chain

checks.check: create: status 200 and Succeeded true
create: the answer carries a ProcessCode and our ReferenceId
create: Status is Original (AutoConfirm was not set)
get: status 200, Succeeded true
get: ReferenceId and ProcessCode are the ones created
delete: status 200, Succeeded true
get after delete: HTTP 404, as the carrier answered it, passed on by the gateway unchanged

cases.title: the same ReferenceId again: identical body gets the existing parcel back; a changed body gets 0x100005 (HTTP 200, Succeeded false), unchanged to the caller

checks.check: the first create succeeded
identical body: HTTP 200, Succeeded true
identical body: the ProcessCode is the first one (nothing new was made)
changed body: HTTP status 200
changed body: Succeeded false
changed body: Error.Code is 0x100005
the parcel made for this case is deleted

cases.title: what the carrier receives (stand-in only): one Authorization of the documented form, a new nonce each time, Accept written by the gateway, nothing of the caller

checks.check: all three answered 200 and the carrier received three requests
exactly one Authorization header on each
it is of the documented form (scheme, account, token, nonce) with the blue account's own account and token
the nonce is different in each request
Accept is exactly application/json, once, though the caller sent text/html
Host is the carrier's name
x-provider-account, cookie and the forwarding headers did not arrive
a header the caller invented (x-evil-probe) did not arrive; nor any x-idp-* header
the caller's Gatekeeper token and the Authorization the caller planted are nowhere in what arrived
no Set-Cookie from the carrier reaches the caller

cases.title: no token, a token for another audience, a forged signature: refused with 401, the carrier gets nothing, gateway-authz is not asked

checks.check: no token: 401
no token: gateway-authz was not asked
no token: the carrier received nothing
another audience: 401
another audience: gateway-authz was not asked
another audience: the carrier received nothing
forged signature: 401
forged signature: gateway-authz was not asked
forged signature: the carrier received nothing

cases.title: tenants: each gets its own account; blue asking for green's account is refused

checks.check: green: 200 and Data is the green account number
green: the carrier saw the green account's credential and no other
blue asking for the green account: 403
the reason is ACCOUNT_NOT_GRANTED
blue asking for the green account: the carrier received nothing

cases.title: a client the register knows but Gatekeeper has no grant for: 403, the carrier gets nothing

checks.check: the reason is ACCOUNT_NOT_GRANTED
the carrier received nothing

cases.title: gateway-authz allows and releases no credential: the gateway itself refuses; a caller's own Authorization does not take its place

checks.check: the PDP is set to allow without a credential
the caller sends nothing of its own: the caller does not get a success (403)
the caller sends nothing of its own: the PDP did allow it (so it is the gateway that refused)
the caller sends nothing of its own: the answer is not the carrier's
the caller sends nothing of its own: the carrier received nothing
the caller's own Authorization after its token: the caller does not get a success (403)
the caller's own Authorization after its token: the PDP did allow it (so it is the gateway that refused)
the caller's own Authorization after its token: the answer is not the carrier's
the caller's own Authorization after its token: the carrier received nothing
the caller's own Authorization before its token: refused (401)
the caller's own Authorization before its token: the carrier received nothing
the PDP is set back to normal
control: with a credential released, the same request is answered 200
control: the carrier got the PDP's credential and not the planted one
the product build of gateway-authz is back and allows again

checks.check: gateway log: none of the 13 secrets of this run, and no value of the carrier's authorization scheme
gateway-authz log: none of the 13 secrets of this run, and no value of the carrier's authorization scheme
standard output: none of the 13 secrets of this run, and no value of the carrier's authorization scheme
result file: none of the 13 secrets of this run, and no value of the carrier's authorization scheme

cases.title: revocation through gateway-control: blue is refused on its next request, gateway-authz is not replaced, green is not touched; restored, blue is served again

checks.check: before: blue is served (whoami 200)
gateway-control revoke: exit 0, REVOKED, the account is revoked and it changed
blue's next request: 403
the reason is ACCOUNT_REVOKED, in the answer and in gateway-authz's decision
blue's request after the revocation: the carrier received nothing
green is not affected: whoami 200 and Data is the green account number
gateway-control revocations: LISTED, blue's account is in the table and no other
gateway-control restore: exit 0, LIFTED, the account is not revoked and it changed
after the restore blue is served again: whoami 200, Succeeded true
...and the carrier received that one request
gateway-authz is the same process throughout (same pid, still running)

gateway-control revoke.said: gateway-control: REVOKED: account-blue is revoked (revocation epoch 1)

cases.title: credential rotation (stand-in only): the credentials file is replaced the way gateway-authz asks; the next request leaves with the new token; a file that does not load changes nothing

checks.check: before: the carrier receives the old token
the file is replaced: the very next request leaves with the new token
green, whose entry did not change, is served as before
replaced by a file that does not load: the next request leaves with the last token that loaded (as P1-DT-04 saw it)
the first file is put back: the next request leaves with the first token again
gateway-authz is the same process throughout (same pid, still running)

cases.title: a create whose result is unknown (stand-in only): after a timeout and after an answer cut off half way the carrier received one POST, none is replayed; the same ReferenceId and body again gives the parcel that exists

checks.check: timeout: the caller gets the gateway's own timeout answer (5xx, not the carrier's) after about the route's 9 seconds
timeout: the carrier received exactly one POST (no replay)
timeout: the carrier did make the parcel (that is why the result is unknown)
timeout: the same ReferenceId and body again: HTTP 200, Succeeded true, the parcel that exists (nothing new)
timeout: the carrier now has one parcel for that ReferenceId and received two POSTs in all
timeout: the parcel is deleted
cut-off answer: the caller does not get a complete answer (a 5xx, or a body that ends before its Content-Length: the status is in the note)
cut-off answer: the carrier received exactly one POST (no replay)
cut-off answer: the carrier did make the parcel (that is why the result is unknown)
cut-off answer: the same ReferenceId and body again: HTTP 200, Succeeded true, the parcel that exists (nothing new)
cut-off answer: the carrier now has one parcel for that ReferenceId and received two POSTs in all
cut-off answer: the parcel is deleted
